entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was in my office reading reports..."
entries.dialogueText: I was in my office reading reports from the ministries about the current situation of the protests.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My next scheduled meeting was with..."
entries.dialogueText: My next scheduled meeting was with Nia and Lileas, to discuss the law enforcement budget. I heard some knocks on the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia entered and took a seat in fron..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia entered and took a seat in front of my desk. Lileas was absent.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Good afternoon, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good afternoon, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Lileas will be late. Apparently th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Lileas will be late. Apparently there was an urgent matter at the Ministry of the Interior she had to attend to. Shouldn't take long.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Very well. Let's wait.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. Let's wait.”
entries.menuText: “Very well. Let's wait.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What urgent matter?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What urgent matter?”
entries.menuText: “What urgent matter?”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“While we wait, why don't we have a..."
entries.dialogueText: “While we wait, why don't we have a little chat?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That's a couple of minutes less of..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's a couple of minutes less of Lileas. Great.”
entries.menuText: “That's a couple of minutes less of Lileas. Great.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“She said something about supply di..."
entries.dialogueText: “She said something about supply distribution for the police forces. Nothing major.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“You wouldn't find many who think o..."
entries.dialogueText: “You wouldn't find many who think otherwise.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She laughed."
entries.dialogueText: She laughed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I returned to my reports and Nia sm..."
entries.dialogueText: I returned to my reports and Nia smoothed back an errant strand of her hair. There was an awkward silence.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“This might come off as a little st..."
entries.dialogueText: “This might come off as a little strange, but I am proud of you.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Despite everything, you are actual..."
entries.dialogueText: “Despite everything, you are actually trying to reform the country.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's *we* Nia, not *me*. I couldn'..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's *we* Nia, not *me*. I couldn't do any of this by myself. So no, I am proud of you.”
entries.menuText: “It's *we* Nia, not *me*. I couldn't do any of this by myself. So no, I am proud of you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Flattery won't work on me. What do..."
entries.dialogueText: “Flattery won't work on me. What do you want?”
entries.menuText: “Flattery won't work on me. What do you want?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“This is just the beginning. There..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is just the beginning. There is so much more to do.”
entries.menuText: “This is just the beginning. There is so much more to do.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Well, thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Well, thank you.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“You certainly have a way with word..."
entries.dialogueText: “You certainly have a way with words, don't you?”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Yes. Although there is a lot to do..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes. Although there is a lot to do, the future looks promising. Thank you for that.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I wouldn't be the President otherw..."
entries.dialogueText: “I wouldn't be the President otherwise.”
entries.menuText: “I wouldn't be the President otherwise.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Fair enough.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Fair enough.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She laughed."
entries.dialogueText: She laughed.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Words are just words. Actions are..."
entries.dialogueText: “Words are just words. Actions are what's important.”
entries.menuText: “Words are just words. Actions are what's important.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“And you seem to be doing well at b..."
entries.dialogueText: “And you seem to be doing well at both so far. Pros are cancelling out the cons for sure.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“How are you really holding up, Ant..."
entries.dialogueText: “How are you really holding up, Anton? Being the President, I mean.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She leaned forward."
entries.dialogueText: She leaned forward.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“You are giving me hope that this c..."
entries.dialogueText: “You are giving me hope that this country can get better.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's not a matter of it *can* or i..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's not a matter of it *can* or it *can't*. It *will* get better. We will make it so.”
entries.menuText: “It's not a matter of it *can* or it *can't*. It *will* get better. We will make it so.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Your support gives me hope as well..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your support gives me hope as well.”
entries.menuText: “Your support gives me hope as well.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“We are all in this together after..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are all in this together after all.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I will follow you anywhere, as lon..."
entries.dialogueText: “I will follow you anywhere, as long as you keep making good decisions for the country.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“For now, I just want to chat.”"
entries.dialogueText: “For now, I just want to chat.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's the hardest thing I have ever..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's the hardest thing I have ever done in my life but it is also the best thing I have ever done in my life.”
entries.menuText: “It's the hardest thing I have ever done in my life but it is also the best thing I have ever done in my life.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Nothing I can't handle.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Nothing I can't handle.”
entries.menuText: “Nothing I can't handle.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It feels like the whole weight of..."
entries.dialogueText: “It feels like the whole weight of the country crushes me down every single day.”
entries.menuText: “It feels like the whole weight of the country crushes me down every single day.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Very well. I will take your word o..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very well. I will take your word on that.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I can imagine. So much responsibil..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can imagine. So much responsibility and so much power at the same time.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Everyone wants to be a president u..."
entries.dialogueText: “Everyone wants to be a president until they are one I guess.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I want to assist you and the count..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want to assist you and the country as best as I can. And to do that I have an idea. We need to eliminate the worst problem we have.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Corruption.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Corruption.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Nonsense. Our government is not a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Nonsense. Our government is not a corrupt government.”
entries.menuText: “Nonsense. Our government is not a corrupt government.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“And how do we do that?”"
entries.dialogueText: “And how do we do that?”
entries.menuText: “And how do we do that?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So finally you come to the point...."
entries.dialogueText: “So finally you come to the point. What do you really want?”
entries.menuText: “So finally you come to the point. What do you really want?”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Our government may not be, but thi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our government may not be, but think about the Supreme Court. Every single one of those Old Guards needs to answer to the law.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“And it's not just the Old Guards...."
entries.dialogueText: “And it's not just the Old Guards. Think about the oligarchs. Everyone knows they have connections in the government. Who knows how deep the rabbit hole goes?”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Please. Can't I hold a normal conv..."
entries.dialogueText: “Please. Can't I hold a normal conversation with my president?”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“As the Minister of Justice, as you..."
entries.dialogueText: “As the Minister of Justice, as you can guess, I have a passion for justice.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“It's high time Old Guards and the..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's high time Old Guards and the Supreme Court stop holding the country in the palm of their hands.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“That's why I want to form a new un..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's why I want to form a new unit. The Anti-Corruption Police. That is my idea.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Give me time to think about it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Give me time to think about it.”
entries.menuText: “Give me time to think about it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That sounds like an excellent idea..."
entries.dialogueText: “That sounds like an excellent idea.”
entries.menuText: “That sounds like an excellent idea.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So? What if the anti-corruption po..."
entries.dialogueText: “So? What if the anti-corruption police gets corrupted? What then?”
entries.menuText: “So? What if the anti-corruption police gets corrupted? What then?”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I'm still figuring out the details..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm still figuring out the details myself right now, but of course there would be safety mechanisms in place.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I'm still figuring out the details..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm still figuring out the details myself right now, but think about the possibilities.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I'm glad you agree. I'm still figu..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm glad you agree. I'm still figuring out the details myself right now, but think about the possibilities.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I want to assist you and the count..."
entries.dialogueText: “I want to assist you and the country as best as I can. Unfortunately, my hands are tied with the current budget allocation we have for the law enforceme--”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Also, one more thing.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Also, one more thing.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“About Lileas.”"
entries.dialogueText: “About Lileas.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I wouldn't trust her if I were--”"
entries.dialogueText: “I wouldn't trust her if I were--”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I hope that I'm not interrupting y..."
entries.dialogueText: “I hope that I'm not interrupting your conversation.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She barely finished the sentence be..."
entries.dialogueText: She barely finished the sentence before we heard a knock on the door. Nia almost jumped in her chair. Lileas Graf entered the room.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“A chat about your emergency decree..."
entries.dialogueText: “A chat about your emergency decree.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“A chat about the so called *reform..."
entries.dialogueText: “A chat about the so called *reform* package.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What of it?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What of it?”
entries.menuText: “What of it?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sure, let's have a chat.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sure, let's have a chat.”
entries.menuText: “Sure, let's have a chat.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I had my reasons.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I had my reasons.”
entries.menuText: “I had my reasons.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“No need to go on defensive. But I..."
entries.dialogueText: “No need to go on defensive. But I will say this.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Nothing. Apart from the fact that..."
entries.dialogueText: “Nothing. Apart from the fact that we are repeating Soll's mistakes again.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Or the fact that this is not what..."
entries.dialogueText: “Or the fact that this is not what we were elected for.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Or the fact that...You get my poin..."
entries.dialogueText: “Or the fact that...You get my point.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You don't agree with my decision.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You don't agree with my decision.”
entries.menuText: “You don't agree with my decision.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Was I not clear enough?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Was I not clear enough?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Times change. Internal and externa..."
entries.dialogueText: “Times change. Internal and external threats have to be eliminated.”
entries.menuText: “Times change. Internal and external threats have to be eliminated.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“You are repeating Soll's mistakes..."
entries.dialogueText: “You are repeating Soll's mistakes again.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“This is not what we were elected f..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is not what we were elected for.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Soll's mistakes? He made this grea..."
entries.dialogueText: “Soll's mistakes? He made this great country what it currently is.”
entries.menuText: “Soll's mistakes? He made this great country what it currently is.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“A place where there are innocent p..."
entries.dialogueText: “A place where there are innocent people getting murdered on the streets because of internal conflicts. Is this your understanding of a great country?”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Times do change but the methods cl..."
entries.dialogueText: “Times do change but the methods clearly not.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She sighed."
entries.dialogueText: She sighed.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I keep thinking about it and I com..."
entries.dialogueText: “I keep thinking about it and I come to the same conclusion every time. There is no way I can get behind this. Don't forget that I have a vote in the Court.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Trust me. I am doing all of this f..."
entries.dialogueText: “Trust me. I am doing all of this for the well being of Sordland.”
entries.menuText: “Trust me. I am doing all of this for the well being of Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Enough. I already made my decision..."
entries.dialogueText: “Enough. I already made my decision and what is left is for you to follow it.”
entries.menuText: “Enough. I already made my decision and what is left is for you to follow it.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She opened her mouth to answer but..."
entries.dialogueText: She opened her mouth to answer but there was knock at the door. Lileas Graf entered the room.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Mr. President. Nia.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. Nia.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“No, not at all. We were just discu..."
entries.dialogueText: “No, not at all. We were just discussing...a few things.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia smiled at Lileas."
entries.dialogueText: Nia smiled at Lileas.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Well then... Let's go straight in...."
entries.dialogueText: “Well then... Let's go straight in.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Go ahead.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Go ahead.”
entries.menuText: “Go ahead.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“We will provide a brief update on..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will provide a brief update on the situation of law enforcement.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“The Ministry of Justice and the Su..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Ministry of Justice and the Supreme Court is working in close collaboration with the Ministry of Interior to address the protests in the country.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“I must add that thanks to the hard..."
entries.dialogueText: “I must add that thanks to the hard work of our judiciary, the law enforcement forces assigned to my ministry are doing their jobs efficiently.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Nia?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Nia?”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded.
entries.menuText: Nod.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas took the seat next to Nia as..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas took the seat next to Nia as she continued talking.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Our efforts ramped up quite a bit..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our efforts ramped up quite a bit recently. Especially after the declaration of the emergency decree.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I would call it the success of our..."
entries.dialogueText: “I would call it the success of our forces on the ground, not due to the judicial branch of our government.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas shot Nia a brief withering g..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas shot Nia a brief withering glance.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“As expected, after the budget redu..."
entries.dialogueText: “As expected, after the budget reduction, the morale of the employees are at an all time low. Many of them face the risk of losing their jobs now.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Agreed. The Ministry of Justice wa..."
entries.dialogueText: “Agreed. The Ministry of Justice was hit the worst. The backlog of the court cases are so high that the judges do not even have time to look at smaller cases, postponing these to months or years later.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“This comes at an even bigger surpr..."
entries.dialogueText: “This comes at an even bigger surprise considering one of the promises that you have made was to focus on our security forces. Yet here we are, thinking about how to fire our security force personnel during mass protests.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“This is ridiculous!”"
entries.dialogueText: “This is ridiculous!”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Yet here we are, with mass protest..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yet here we are, with mass protests happening in the country, talking about how we have to fire our security force personnel.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“This causes a disastrous bottlenec..."
entries.dialogueText: “This causes a disastrous bottleneck. How can we deal justice if we can't even find time for these cases?”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“As expected, the budget increase h..."
entries.dialogueText: “As expected, the budget increase has boosted morale of the employees in the law enforcement agencies. In these dire times, my people and Nia's people are especially delighted.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Agreed. At the Ministry of Justice..."
entries.dialogueText: “Agreed. At the Ministry of Justice, we are very happy with the decision as well. The backlog of the court cases are dwindling and we have started to fulfil the needs of the current situation.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“And for that, all I will say is......"
entries.dialogueText: “And for that, all I will say is... Bravo! This was an excellent decision.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I think you will be glad to hear t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think you will be glad to hear that the support for you among the forces is at an all time high, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“This came as a pleasant surprise t..."
entries.dialogueText: “This came as a pleasant surprise to many in the Ministry of the Interior since it was not even one of our campaign promises.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Certainly a step in the right dire..."
entries.dialogueText: “Certainly a step in the right direction.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“The current budget has dampened ho..."
entries.dialogueText: “The current budget has dampened hopes of more funding in the force.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Agreed. Many in the Ministry of Ju..."
entries.dialogueText: “Agreed. Many in the Ministry of Justice hoped for an increase and were not satisfied with the decision.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“The decisions made needs to reflec..."
entries.dialogueText: “The decisions made needs to reflect the current situation of the country. This was certainly not the right decision when we are dealing with mass protests.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“This comes at an even bigger surpr..."
entries.dialogueText: “This comes at an even bigger surprise considering one of the promises that you have made was to focus on our security forces. Yet here we are, exactly where we started at.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Yet here we are, with mass protest..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yet here we are, with mass protests happening in the country. We are standing exactly where we were before.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“Regardless, this means we will hav..."
entries.dialogueText: “Regardless, this means we will have to deal with the growing court backlog. It is manageable but it will be a challenge for sure.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you. I am glad you approve.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you. I am glad you approve.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you. I am glad you approve.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I did what was expected from me. T..."
entries.dialogueText: “I did what was expected from me. That's all.”
entries.menuText: “I did what was expected from me. That's all.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Of course it was the right decisio..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course it was the right decision. I made it, after all.”
entries.menuText: “Of course it was the right decision. I made it after all.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Of course.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of course.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia cast a sidelong look at Lileas."
entries.dialogueText: Nia cast a sidelong look at Lileas.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Nia nodded.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Of course.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of course.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Of course.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Of course.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Don't worry. I am sure you will ma..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't worry. I am sure you will manage.”
entries.menuText: “Don't worry. I am sure you will manage.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I had to make sacrifices for the g..."
entries.dialogueText: “I had to make sacrifices for the good of Sordland.”
entries.menuText: “I had to make sacrifices for the good of Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You will do as you are told with w..."
entries.dialogueText: “You will do as you are told with what you have.”
entries.menuText: “You will do as you are told with what you have.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“These sacrifices might've very wel..."
entries.dialogueText: “These sacrifices might've very well damaged the structural integrity of Sordland.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“That remains to be seen but the ri..."
entries.dialogueText: “That remains to be seen but the ripples are already being felt across the country. I hope this decision is not the beginning of something bad.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Tell that to the policemen on the..."
entries.dialogueText: “Tell that to the policemen on the ground when they are overwhelmed by the protestors.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“The ripples are already being felt..."
entries.dialogueText: “The ripples are already being felt across the country. I hope this decision is not the beginning of something bad.”

entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“The Community Police would be pick..."
entries.dialogueText: “The Community Police would be picked from trustworthy members of the local community. It will give us greater coverage over the country to combat criminals.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“This would especially come in hand..."
entries.dialogueText: “This would especially come in handy when dealing with corruption in higher positions. The Supreme Court and oligarchs that meddle in politics are just a few examples.”

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: "“While some in the law enforcement..."
entries.dialogueText: “While some in the law enforcement agencies look at this negatively we do believe it has the potential to be successful.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“This would be a new force that wou..."
entries.dialogueText: “This would be a new force that would be in charge of handling internal security and intelligence matters.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“The primary aim of this program is..."
entries.dialogueText: “The primary aim of this program is to detect and prevent subversive elements before they take any harmful action against the state.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“This will come in handy to deal wi..."
entries.dialogueText: “This will come in handy to deal with the protests.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I must thank you, Mr. President, f..."
entries.dialogueText: “I must thank you, Mr. President, for the support with the riot gear. The Police Forces definitely needed it.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I must say, Mr. President, that yo..."
entries.dialogueText: “I must say, Mr. President, that your lack of support to the law enforcement is taking its toll on the police forces. They are crumbling away... But we'll talk about that soon.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“What makes things worse is that ou..."
entries.dialogueText: “What makes things worse is that our request to fund the lacking riot control equipment has been ignored.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“At least you have fulfilled our re..."
entries.dialogueText: “At least you have fulfilled our request to fund additional riot control equipment that will allow us to maintain order to some degree.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“At least you have fulfilled our re..."
entries.dialogueText: “At least you have fulfilled our request to fund additional riot control equipment that will allow us to maintain order to some degree.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“What makes things worse is that ou..."
entries.dialogueText: “What makes things worse is that our request to fund the lacking riot control equipment has been ignored.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“The situation is still not good.”"
entries.dialogueText: “The situation is still not good.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“A wise choice.”"
entries.dialogueText: “A wise choice.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“I am sorry for being late. There w..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am sorry for being late. There was an important matter at the ministry. The security forces of Bergia are arbitrarily not cooperating with my department and created some minor annoyances.”

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: "“Luckily they didn't completely bot..."
entries.dialogueText: “Luckily they didn't completely botch their tasks, and actually uncovered a large network of priests that are recruiting Bergians for the Bludish Freedom Front.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This sounds very significant. Do y..."
entries.dialogueText: "This sounds very significant. Do you want to explain more?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good. Do your best to keep the mis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. Do your best to keep the miscommunication with the Governor's forces to a minimum. We need to take the war against terror seriously."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You were late, Ms. Graf. But now t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You were late, Ms. Graf. But now that you are here, let's begin with the meeting."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""The issue was a miscommunication a..."
entries.dialogueText: "The issue was a miscommunication about an ongoing investigation inside Bergia. But as I said, it didn't affect the results in a negative way."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""The investigation itself, however,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The investigation itself, however, revealed some troubling facts. We suspect the existence of a massive network of BFF-aligned priests currently serving in Bergia."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""We have discovered that most of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have discovered that most of the existing Golcondist sanctuaries and communities inside Bergia are indeed working directly for the BFF."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Several reports also point to a po..."
entries.dialogueText: "Several reports also point to a possible infiltration of the Dastnurist and Wruhecist communities by these Golcondist sects. May the Divine God forgive us if this is true."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you for the brief report, Li..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the brief report, Lileas."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is worrying news. Keep follow..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is worrying news. Keep following the lead. We cannot let these sects divide our society."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Tell me about the Golcondists.""
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me about the Golcondists."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""If you want my honest opinion, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you want my honest opinion, they are a group of dangerous radicals who follow a warped interpretation of Wruhecist Nurity. Most faithful Nurists wouldn't want to have anything to do with them."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I don't appreciate you speaking li..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't appreciate you speaking like that, Lileas. The majority of the Bludish community in Sordland practice Golcondism."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Don't normalize it, Ms. Morgna. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't normalize it, Ms. Morgna. They are a plague on this earth. Even orthodox Wruhecists do not like them."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""As a devout Dastnurist myself, I h..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a devout Dastnurist myself, I haven't experienced any divide in Sordland between our religion and mainstream Wruhecism. Bless St. Dast -- all practitioners of Nurity live in peace here..."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""...Except the Golcondists, of cour..."
entries.dialogueText: "...Except the Golcondists, of course. Their extremist beliefs are an abomination. And unfortunately, after the Wruhecist Revolution in Derdia, now we also have a Golcondist state that uses the influence of their faith internationally."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""As a matter of fact, the Nurist Re..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a matter of fact, the Nurist Republic of Derdia is one of the BFF's suspected supporters. Their aims are clearly one and the same."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Of course, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you for the explanation, Lil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the explanation, Lileas."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you suspect any other countries..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you suspect any other countries are supporting the BFF together with Derdia?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Keep following that lead. We canno..."
entries.dialogueText: "Keep following that lead. We cannot let countries like Derdia try and destabilize us with religion."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Of course, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I suspect the Kingdom of Rizia is..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suspect the Kingdom of Rizia is involved in this along with Derdia. However, the biggest player is Rumburg and we have clear evidence of their interference. Our focus must be on them."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I don't think we should damage our..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think we should damage our international relations over unproven suspicions. Our direct neighbors have much more influence over us."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Besides, this isn't the topic of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Besides, this isn't the topic of this meeting. I think it's best to discuss this in an external security meeting -- when or if -- enough proof is collected."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You're right.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're right."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I thought you'd be familiar with t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you'd be familiar with them as a Bergian yourself."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I thought you might have encounter..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought you might have encountered them during your university days."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""To be honest, I couldn't care less..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be honest, I couldn't care less about religion."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""May the Divine God save your soul.""
entries.dialogueText: "May the Divine God save your soul."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""If this is over, why don't we star..."
entries.dialogueText: "If this is over, why don't we start the meeting?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Unfortunately, due to my limited a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, due to my limited authority in the Special Zone of Bergia, I cannot control their operations."
